title: Security Margin of SKINNYee
summary: SKINNYee uses a distinct tweakey-extension method, but determining its security margin remains open.

formal_statement.body: SKINNYee is a tweakable block cipher based on SKINNYe-64-256 version 2, with a $128$-bit key, a $(256+3)$-bit tweak, and a $64$-bit plaintext block. Its method for extending the tweakey size differs from another proposed extension method. Determine the security margin of SKINNYee under its distinct tweakey-extension method.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of the SKINNYee tweakable block cipher and its tweakey schedule.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the security margin of SKINNYee under its distinct tweakey-extension method.

citations.label: Mind the TWEAKEY Schedule: Cryptanalysis on SKINNYe-64-256

progress.summary: The source introduces SKINNYee and notes that its tweakey-size extension differs from the method proposed in the paper. It explicitly calls exploration of SKINNYee's security margin an interesting open problem.
